item.title: Version 2.1.2 — Smarter Multi-Display Routing
item.description:
Version 2.1.2 — Smarter Multi-Display Routing

  • Automatic display routing sends touch to the right screen on multi-monitor setups
  • New Identify Display… command lets you choose which display the touchscreen controls
  • You can re-identify and switch the target display at any time after confirming
  • Fixed crashes and lifecycle issues with the Identify Display overlay window
  • More reliable touchscreen activation after a cold boot

item.title: Version 2.1.1 — Critical Activation Fix
item.description:
🚨 Critical Bug Fix — License Activation

All paying customers unable to activate in v2.1.0 and earlier.

Fixed: Gumroad license verification now uses the correct API parameter (product_id). Previous versions returned "the product_id parameter is required" error.

If you purchased and could not activate: Update to v2.1.1 and re-enter your license key in Settings → Activation.

What's in v2.1.x

  • Interactive touchscreen setup wizard with auto-diagnostics
  • Multi-display calibration and pointer acceleration fixes
  • New brand app icon

item.title: Version 2.0.1
item.description:
Version 2.0.1

  • Fixed a crash on touchscreen connect — the built-in device profiles are now correctly bundled in the app
  • Improves out-of-the-box recognition for ILITEK and other profiled touchscreens
